episodes.title: Abdul El-Sayed tours Epstein Files Reading Room in Detroit
episodes.description:
Democratic candidate for U.S. Senate Abdul El-Sayed toured a public exhibition of the Donald J. Trump and Jeffrey Epstein Memorial Reading Room on the day it opened at The Norwood, 6531 Woodward Ave. in Detroit on Wednesday, Oct. 21 2026.

El-Sayed, U.S. Sen. Chris Murphy and U.S. Rep. Maxwell Frost met with survivors Sharlene Rochard and Liz Stein as the exhibition, which features the currently available files along with copies that visitors can read, a memorial to victims and artwork, opened to the public.

Jacob Hamilton | MLive.com
